_doc: E0-B labeled loopy/good clip manifest (THE-FINN, 2026-07-15, for W's meter validation, plan section E0). Mined from run_meta.json findings fields + docs/a2a-loop-attractor.md + journals + WORKLOG, per W's ask -- NOT from recall alone, every path verified to exist on /run/media/kim/Mantu before inclusion. Schema: clips[] = the binary labeled set for AUC scoring; ambiguous[] = disagreement cases (metric vs ear) kept separate on purpose, informative but not clean binary labels; reference_only[] = clips with an explicit numeric loopiness score whose own meter-author caveat says they are NOT confirmed pathological (normal repetitive-genre self-similarity in the 0.67-0.71 range) -- useful as a calibration floor, not as loopy-class training/test labels.
shortfall_note: HONEST COUNT: 8 loopy / 15 good with high-confidence direct ear-verdicts -- short of the >=20/>=20 target on the loopy side. This is the real state of what's recorded in the repo + on-disk run_meta.json sidecars as of 2026-07-15; not padded to hit the number. Closing the gap needs either fresh Kim listening calls on new clips, or loosening confidence tier (see ambiguous[]/reference_only[] below) -- W/Kim's call, not mine to fabricate.
